# Salesmate | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| SMB Sales Automation | Verify that SMB sales automation really reduces manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Sales and Support Handoff | Use “List or Interactive Entry — Form Customer and Opportunity — Advance Phase — Trigger Next Step — Manage Review” as the main link to verify whether the sales and support handover really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Offer and product management | Verify that quotes and product management are really reducing manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Multi-channel customer communication | The main link is “list or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk to verify whether multi-channel customer communication really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
